tasks.title: Gemini Live voice ship/remove decision
tasks.problem: The Gemini Live voice path creates a mutually-exclusive fork in the task registry: T17/T20/T21 ship Gemini, while T18/T19 remove it. No single decision task forces the fleet to pick one branch, which will lead to planning deadlock.
acceptance_criteria: Decision outcome is recorded as SHIP_GEMINI or REMOVE_GEMINI
Legal, product, and safety sign-off is captured for the chosen direction
T17-T21 are unblocked only after the decision is recorded and communicated
tasks.notes: T17-T21 are gated by this decision. Do not start those tasks until product and legal confirm the direction.

tasks.title: Canonical env schema, EAS alignment, and Expo capabilities
tasks.problem: Production env keys are fragmented across eas.json, metro.config.js, src/config.ts, and .detoxrc.js. eas.json production sets EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL which src/config.ts ignores, so release builds silently fall back to a hardcoded Cloudflare tunnel. metro.config.js also mutates the source tree by writing src/__env__.ts at load time.
acceptance_criteria: eas.json production profile uses TBOT_API_URL, TBOT_AI_URL, and WS_URL keys consumed by src/config.ts
Hardcoded Cloudflare fallback removed from src/config.ts; production fallback is Render URL or fails closed
metro.config.js no longer writes src/__env__.ts; env injection uses Expo EXPO_PUBLIC_* handling or process.env
.detoxrc.js launchArgs align with the canonical env schema
app.json declares expo-notifications plugin, orientation, scheme, and iOS/Android background modes
package.json declares engines.node and a browserslist
tasks.notes: Cross-repo coordination required: confirm canonical API/AI/WS URL contract with backend and Render deployment before merging EAS changes.

tasks.title: Jest, lint, and package hygiene
tasks.problem: package.json has duplicate build/typecheck scripts, a stale expo-av Jest mapper, a transform-ignore list that omits ESM packages used at runtime, and no engines/browserslist. eslint.config.js disables no-require-imports globally.
acceptance_criteria: Only one of build or typecheck scripts remains (keep typecheck)
expo-av moduleNameMapper removed from Jest config
transformIgnorePatterns whitelists @orbital-systems, @google/genai, lucide-react-native, posthog-react-native, @sentry/react-native, and axios
@typescript-eslint/no-require-imports override is scoped to metro.config.js and babel.config.js only
engines.node and browserslist are declared
tasks.notes: Touches package.json scripts and Jest config only; coordinate with T01 on package.json to avoid merge conflicts.

tasks.title: Restore Android BLE autolinking
tasks.problem: react-native.config.js opts react-native-ble-plx out of Android autolinking, disabling the core robot-pairing flow on Android.
acceptance_criteria: react-native-ble-plx is no longer opted out of Android autolinking
Either the library is upgraded to a React Native 0.83-compatible release or the override is replaced with a documented, time-boxed fallback
Android debug build succeeds
tasks.notes: May require upgrading react-native-ble-plx or pinning the RN architecture; verify on an Android device/emulator. The Jest verification test asserts config correctness; the build_gate asserts native Android compilation.

tasks.title: BLE scan readiness, RSSI capture, and timeout alignment
tasks.problem: requestBlePermissions returns 'granted' unconditionally on iOS, so Bluetooth-off/denied users see silent scan failures. The scan also discards RSSI, picks the first allowlisted device regardless of proximity, and uses a 10 s timeout that diverges from the 30 s machine spec.
acceptance_criteria: iOS permission helper checks CBCentralManager state and returns poweredOff/unauthorized when appropriate
BleDeviceCandidate includes rssi and toCandidate preserves it
scanForTJBotDevices sorts allowed candidates by descending RSSI and rejects signals below a configurable threshold
BLE_CONFIG.SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS is 30000 to match the XState machine spec
PairSearchScreen surfaces a clear 'Turn on Bluetooth' prompt when the state is not poweredOn
tasks.notes: Mock react-native-ble-plx state subscription in tests; no backend contract change.

tasks.title: BLE provisioning cleanup, retry, and error mapping
tasks.problem: PairWifiScreen and PairConnectingScreen only set a cancelled boolean on unmount, leaving native BLE/Wi-Fi operations running and potentially orphaning the robot. connectProvisionableDevice and provisionWifi are single-attempt, ProvisioningError has coarse codes, and PairFailedScreen shows generic recovery text.
acceptance_criteria: PairWifiScreen useEffect cleanup calls device.disconnect() and stopProvisionSearch()
PairConnectingScreen useEffect cleanup disconnects the ESP device and stops search
connectProvisionableDevice and provisionWifi use a small retry helper for transient BLE disconnects
ProvisioningError codes map to the XState machine's E-PROV-001..005 codes
PairFailedScreen renders context-aware recovery actions based on the mapped error code
PairWifiScreen supports pull-to-refresh / 'Scan again' for the Wi-Fi list
tasks.notes: Cross-repo: confirm backend claim endpoint semantics before adding pre-provisioning claim logic.

tasks.title: Move pairing mutable state into an actor/store
tasks.problem: pairingSession.ts stores activeCandidate and connectedDevice as mutable module-level variables, which leaks across screen instances, survives unmount, and risks corruption on concurrent pairing attempts.
acceptance_criteria: activeCandidate and connectedDevice live in a Zustand store or XState actor instead of module-level let bindings
The public API of pairingSession.ts (setPairingCandidate, getPairingCandidate, setConnectedEspDevice, getConnectedEspDevice, clearPairingSession) remains stable for existing screens
clearPairingSession still eagerly disconnects the ESP device
Unit tests verify store lifecycle and cleanup
tasks.notes: Keep the existing imperative API so T05 screen changes are not invalidated.

tasks.title: Harden BLE allowlist with service UUID and manufacturer data
tasks.problem: isAllowlistedDevice only matches name/id prefixes, so a maliciously renamed peripheral could pass the filter. There is no validation of the advertised provisioning service UUID or manufacturer data.
acceptance_criteria: isAllowlistedDevice also validates that the candidate advertises the configured SERVICE_UUID
Manufacturer-data check is added if firmware exposes a TJBot manufacturer ID
Existing allowlist prefixes remain supported for backwards compatibility
Unit tests reject renamed peripherals that do not expose the expected service UUID
tasks.notes: Coordination required: confirm firmware manufacturer data layout and service UUID before enforcing the new check.

tasks.title: Explicit realtime WebSocket URL and contract parity
tasks.problem: src/services/ws/realtime.ts derives the observer WebSocket root from the HTTP base URL with fragile path stripping, which is the likely source of the documented mobile/backend WebSocket path contract mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: Config exposes a deterministic WS_URL resolution that uses ENV.WS_URL when set and falls back to a documented, backend-approved default
httpBaseToWsRoot derivation is removed or isolated behind a loud deprecation comment
buildObserverUrl uses the canonical WS_URL without fragile string manipulation
A contract test asserts that mobile's resolved observer path matches the backend OpenAPI/modular route contract
tasks.notes: Coordination required: confirm the exact backend observer WS path before changing the default. T08's WS URL work uses the canonical env schema established by T01.

tasks.title: Unify authenticated axios client, auth invalidation, and retry/idempotency
tasks.problem: src/services/http/client.ts and src/services/api/ai.ts duplicate Bearer + 401 refresh logic; setAiAuthInvalidatedHandler is never registered, so AI-session expiry does not force the UI back to login. Retryable errors are only tagged, not retried, and request-id generation diverges from idempotency.js.
acceptance_criteria: A single createAuthenticatedClient({ baseURL, timeout, normalizeErrors }) factory serves both REST and AI traffic
AuthContext registers one auth-invalidated handler that covers all authenticated clients
Retryable 429/503/504 responses are retried with exponential backoff for idempotent methods
Request-id generation is consolidated with idempotency.js and attached to mutating requests
AI stub functions (transcribe, chat, synthesize) use the shared client
tasks.notes: Cross-repo auth contract: confirm refresh response shape and idempotency-key behavior with backend.

tasks.title: Forward raw WebSocket events and harden reconnect logic
tasks.problem: realtime.ts and xiaozhi-device.ts replace original Error/CloseEvent data with generic strings, removing codes and reasons needed for production debugging. The reconnect loop has no jitter, no max attempt limit, and no offline awareness.
acceptance_criteria: onError callbacks receive the original error code/reason or a structured object
onClose callbacks receive code, reason, and wasClean
Reconnect delay includes jitter and caps attempts before surfacing a terminal error
Reconnect pauses while NetInfo reports offline and resumes when online
Telemetry includes raw close codes for production debugging
tasks.notes: Mock WebSocket and @react-native-community/netinfo in tests.

tasks.title: Parallelize household fetches and replace arbitrary timeouts
tasks.problem: HouseholdContext.refresh() fetches households and children sequentially with a 12 s fallback timeout, blocking the cold start. There is no request cancellation on unmount and no cache for instantaneous hydration.
acceptance_criteria: refresh() fetches households and active-household children in parallel with Promise.all
An AbortController or axios cancel token aborts in-flight requests on unmount
The 12 s arbitrary timeout is removed or replaced by an operation-specific deadline with telemetry
The last known household list is cached in AsyncStorage for instantaneous hydration
Provider value object is memoized to avoid re-render cascades
tasks.notes: Keep the existing public context API; changes are internal to refresh() and memoization.

tasks.title: Remove API shims and consolidate secure-storage wrappers
tasks.problem: src/api/client.ts, src/api/tokens.ts, and src/api/learning.ts are shallow re-exports that fragment import paths. src/services/http/tokens.ts and src/services/storage/secureStore.ts duplicate expo-secure-store wrappers.
acceptance_criteria: src/api/* files are deleted and all imports point to src/services/* directly
Token helpers in src/services/http/tokens.ts are moved into src/services/storage/secureStore.ts or use its typed helpers
AuthContext and HouseholdContext import storage helpers from the consolidated module
No source file imports from @/api/*
tasks.notes: Sequential to T09/T11 because AuthContext and HouseholdContext are already touched by those tasks.

tasks.title: Delete dead providers and unused hooks/components
tasks.problem: AppProviders.tsx and ThemeProvider.tsx are unused wrappers; useOfflineSync.ts, useStreamingTranscript.ts, useVoiceActivity.ts, useLatencyBudget.ts, and LatencyHud.tsx have no production callers but still ship in the bundle and mislead new contributors.
acceptance_criteria: Listed files are deleted and git history is the only reference
No production source file imports any deleted symbol
npm test and typecheck still pass after deletion
Dead-code coverage of these files drops to zero
tasks.notes: If useVoiceActivity is later needed as a fallback, reintroduce it as part of T21 instead.

tasks.title: Cap voice assistant message history
tasks.problem: voiceAssistantStore.addMessage appends every user/AI turn without a cap, causing memory pressure and slow transcript re-renders during long voice sessions.
acceptance_criteria: addMessage caps the messages array (e.g., last 100 turns)
Oldest messages are evicted deterministically
Full history can still be fetched/persisted server-side if needed
Unit tests verify cap behavior
tasks.notes: Remove any __reset helpers used only to mutate the cap in tests.

tasks.title: Migrate household server state to React Query with defaults
tasks.problem: Server state lives inside HouseholdContext instead of React Query, so the app does not benefit from caching, background refetch, stale-while-revalidate, or optimistic updates. QueryClient is also created with no defaults.
acceptance_criteria: QueryProvider configures sensible defaults (1 retry, networkMode: 'online', refetchOnReconnect, staleTime per feature)
HouseholdContext uses useQuery/useMutation for households and children
Mutations invalidate the relevant query keys
Cold-start loading state is preserved while server state hydrates
tasks.notes: Build on T11's parallel fetch/cancellation work; do not duplicate it.

tasks.title: Wire lesson session screens to the lessonSessionMachine
tasks.problem: createLessonSessionMachine is exported and tested, but ConnectingScreen hard-codes a 1.8 s timeout before navigating to GreetingScreen regardless of whether the WebSocket/audio layer is ready.
acceptance_criteria: ConnectingScreen consumes the lesson session actor state instead of a fixed timeout
Navigation to GreetingScreen happens on SESSION_STARTED or equivalent machine event
RECONNECTING and error terminals are observable from the screen
Machine state is provided via sessionContext to child screens
tasks.notes: Coordinate with T08/T10 on WebSocket ready-state semantics.

tasks.title: Wire Gemini Live voice UI behind a feature gate
tasks.problem: The Gemini Live layer (useGeminiConversation, src/components/gemini/*, native modules) is implemented but unreachable, creating dead code and false test confidence.
acceptance_criteria: A feature flag gates the Gemini conversation screen/route
A navigable GeminiConversationScreen renders SukaAvatar, TranscriptPanel, and ControlBar
The route is registered only when the flag is enabled
No native modules are removed in this task
tasks.notes: Product decision required: choose this task OR T18/T19. COPPA/copy and backend voice budget must be reviewed before enabling.

tasks.title: Delete the orphaned Gemini Live JS layer
tasks.problem: ~3,500 lines of JS/TS for the Gemini voice path ship unused, including useGeminiConversation.ts, src/components/gemini/*, the PcmStreamPlayer shim, and native-module TypeScript wrappers.
acceptance_criteria: Listed JS/TS files and the src/components/gemini directory are deleted
No production source imports deleted symbols
package.json removes unused Gemini-related dependencies if any
npm test and typecheck pass
tasks.notes: Product decision required: choose this task (and T19) OR T17. Confirm with product/legal that the Gemini voice path is not needed for alpha.

tasks.title: Remove orphaned Gemini native modules and dependencies
tasks.problem: Custom iOS and Android native modules for VoiceMic, PcmStream, and VoiceSession are shipped but unused when the Gemini layer is removed.
acceptance_criteria: Native module source directories are removed from iOS (VoiceMic/PcmStream/VoiceSession) and Android (voicemic/pcmstream/voicesession)
package.json no longer references dependencies only used by the Gemini native layer
iOS and Android debug builds succeed after cleanup
tasks.notes: Verify with the firmware/mobile build pipeline before deleting native directories. The Jest verification test asserts config correctness; the build_gate asserts native iOS and Android compilation.
tasks.build_gate: npx react-native run-android && npx react-native run-ios

tasks.title: Implement the documented child-safety shim
tasks.problem: src/services/ai/safety/README.md documents a complete Layer 1/2/3 child-safety system, but the directory contains only the README. There is no deterministic input/output guard.
acceptance_criteria: checkInput and checkOutput are deterministic, synchronous, and fail-closed
blocklist.v1.json has a verifiable integritySha256 and 80-120 regexes
assemblePersona substitutes age bracket, theme, and vocab deterministically and stays under 2 kB
Telemetry emits safety_block_event and safety_shim_error with no plaintext terms
The conversation hook calls checkInput on mic chunks and checkOutput on transcript chunks
tasks.notes: Legal/safety must approve blocklist and persona content before merge; the verification test only checks structure/count, not content approval.

tasks.title: Consolidate avatar and waveform primitives on Reanimated
tasks.problem: Two competing visual languages exist (Gemini SukaAvatar/WaveVisualizer/ParticleEffect vs lesson-session Robot/WaveBars/RobotFace). They do not share primitives, duplicate animation logic, and bind the JS thread.
acceptance_criteria: One canonical waveform component is used across voice and lesson paths
SukaAvatar, RobotFace, and RobotBody animation is driven by Reanimated worklets where possible
WaveVisualizer no longer recreates 16 Animated.Value/timing loops on every audioLevel change
reduceMotion is respected by all animated avatar/waveform components
Duplicate emoji/SVG inline icons are replaced by the icon library from T29
tasks.notes: Only run if T17 is chosen. If T18/T19 are chosen, delete the Gemini components instead of refactoring them.

tasks.title: Delete legacy screen trees and phantom aliases
tasks.problem: src/screens/* and src/app/screens/* contain dead screens with stale route names; src/navigation/types.ts still exports a LegacyMainStackParamList that only the dead screens use.
acceptance_criteria: Legacy screen files and src/app/screens directory are deleted
LegacyMainStackParamList and MainStackScreenProps are removed from src/navigation/types.ts
No production source imports deleted symbols
Typecheck and navigation tests pass
tasks.notes: Verify no deep-link or notification payload still references deleted route names.

tasks.title: Add unknown deep-link fallback and logging
tasks.problem: Unknown TJBot:// deep links are silently dropped with no logging or fallback screen, making marketing-link and notification misconfigurations hard to debug.
acceptance_criteria: navigationTargetForDeepLinkUrl returns a NotFoundScreen target for unknown paths instead of null
AppNavigator routes unrecognized URLs to the fallback screen
Unknown paths are logged to Sentry/analytics with the full URL
Existing notification deep links continue to work
tasks.notes: Keep the existing manual-notification path logic intact.

tasks.title: Add nav-graph-data.json alignment test
tasks.problem: nav-graph-data.json contains 134 states but no edges, and it is not validated against ROUTE_MAP or feature state files, so visualizations and scripts drift from the runtime registry.
acceptance_criteria: A test asserts that every state entry in nav-graph-data.json maps to the same screen file recorded in ROUTE_MAP/feature states
Orphaned entries are listed and the test fails until they are removed or documented
Edges are populated from actual navigators or the file is retired
tasks.notes: This is a regression-prevention test; it may require updating nav-graph-data.json rather than source code. The acceptance criterion involving edges is a product/tech-debt decision and may need escalation.

tasks.title: Extract LessonSessionParams and normalize route param types
tasks.problem: src/navigation/routes.ts repeats the same ~15-field lesson-session param shape 23 times and uses undefined | { ... } for optional params, which is verbose and error-prone.
acceptance_criteria: A LessonSessionParams type is extracted and reused across all lesson-session screens
Optional route params use { field?: string } instead of undefined | { field?: string }
TypeScript still type-checks all navigation calls
tasks.notes: Coordinate with T17 if a Gemini route is added to routes.ts. T17 dependency is conditional: only include if the SHIP_GEMINI decision is made.

tasks.title: Refactor ModalNavigator to a single MainTabNavigator
tasks.problem: ModalNavigator mounts five independent MainTabNavigator instances (one per tab), bloating memory and complicating deep-link state handling.
acceptance_criteria: ModalNavigator contains a single MainTabNavigator instance
Route params select the active tab on deep-link entry
Existing tab-level navigation tests are updated and pass
Memory snapshot shows only one tab host mounted at a time
tasks.notes: Update tests that assert the current tab-host-per-route structure.

tasks.title: Harden ReconnectingOverlay timeout cleanup
tasks.problem: ReconnectingOverlay starts a 2400 ms timeout that can navigate away from a later screen if the overlay is dismissed before the timeout fires.
acceptance_criteria: The timeout is cleared on navigation.addListener('beforeRemove')
No navigation occurs after the overlay has been removed
The existing happy-path retry behavior is preserved
tasks.notes: Use RNTL to simulate navigation away before the timeout fires.

tasks.title: Unify design-token surface and migrate legacy imports
tasks.problem: Two parallel token systems exist: low-level tokens/*.ts and legacy-semantic.ts. Production components mostly import legacy-semantic.ts while newer primitives consume low-level tokens, creating a two-authority problem.
acceptance_criteria: legacy-semantic.ts is re-implemented as a pure transform of low-level tokens
Components listed in scope import from the unified tokens and remove local ad-hoc palettes like Device-tokens.ts
No production component imports both token systems for the same semantic value
Visual regression tests or snapshot tests show no unintended style changes
tasks.notes: MainTabNavigator token migration is handled by T26 to avoid overlapping edits.

tasks.title: Centralize icon library and remove inline SVG/emoji
tasks.problem: There is no central icon library; inline SVGs and emoji glyphs are scattered across components, hurting accessibility and cross-platform consistency.
acceptance_criteria: A typed Icon component backed by lucide-react-native is exported from src/design-system/icons
All components in scope replace inline SVG/emoji with Icon
Accessibility labels are preserved or improved
No inline emoji remain in the listed components
tasks.notes: lucide-react-native is already a dependency; this task is mostly find/replace and type checking.

tasks.title: Haptics, Box typing, and Text primitive compliance
tasks.problem: Pressable uses React Native Vibration with a 10 ms duration; Box silently drops percentage widths and has no token resolution for borderColor; Text hard-codes 'Nunito' and ignores the typography.fonts token.
acceptance_criteria: Pressable uses expo-haptics impactAsync with light impact, platform gating, and reduce-motion awareness
Box supports percentage width/height strings or restricts prop types; borderColor resolves tokens
Text derives font family from tokens.typography.fonts and supports lineHeight/letterSpacing props
tasks.notes: expo-haptics is already mocked in tests.

tasks.title: Toast reduce-motion awareness and queue cap
tasks.problem: Toast.tsx uses Animated for fade-in but not exit, and auto-dismiss timers do not respect reduced motion or cap queue length.
acceptance_criteria: useReduceMotion() gates entrance/exit animations
Exit animation is symmetric with entrance
Visible toast queue length is capped to prevent off-screen stacking
Auto-dismiss timers are cleared on unmount
tasks.notes: Keep the existing ToastProvider public API unchanged.

tasks.title: Fix failing unit-test baseline and native mocks
tasks.problem: npm test currently reports 9 failed suites due to a broken openapi.json symlink, stale route-coverage expectations, a mismatched API-config assertion, an async race in parent-today-screen, and shallow native mocks.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/api-contract-sync.mjs uses a checked-in or environment-configured OpenAPI fixture instead of a broken symlink
route-coverage-script test expectation matches the current screen/route count
tests/api/config.test.ts passes with the current hosted fallback URL
parent-today-screen test is deterministic (waits for loading state or mocks network)
Native mocks model stateful behavior (BLE manager state, audio permission granted by default)
npm test exits 0 (zero failed suites), with unit test fixes implemented as part of this task
tasks.notes: This is the foundational testing task; all other verification tests depend on a green baseline.

tasks.title: Replace stub API-contract gate and split docs-integrity CI
tasks.problem: scripts/check-api-contract-sync.mjs is a 5-line stub that always exits 0, so the CI contract-sync gate passes without verifying backend/mobile drift. Docs-integrity validation is run inside the same job as build/test, blocking the whole pipeline on stale Mermaid headers.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs scripts/api-contract-sync.mjs instead of the stub and fails on endpoint drift
scripts/check-api-contract-sync.mjs is deleted or delegates to the real script
Docs-integrity checks (flows, sequences, ERD, usecases) run in a separate workflow/job
mobile-quality job focuses on lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, and Expo config
tasks.notes: Coordination required: confirm backend OpenAPI fixture path and ownership with the Backend role.

tasks.title: Add Jest coverage thresholds
tasks.problem: Jest has no collectCoverage, coverageThreshold, or coveragePathIgnorePatterns, so the test suite grows without a coverage gate.
acceptance_criteria: package.json adds collectCoverage and coverageThreshold for src/ (start at 50% lines)
coveragePathIgnorePatterns excludes generated, native, and dead code scheduled for deletion
CI has a coverage job that fails when coverage drops below the threshold
Coverage report is uploaded as an artifact
tasks.notes: Thresholds can be ratcheted up over time; the initial goal is preventing untested file growth.

notes: T32 (fix-failing-test-baseline) is a fleet-wide integration prerequisite; no verification-bearing task should be started before T32 is green.
